email.subject: Quick fix for Blue Pipe Group's site
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I looked at Blue Pipe Group's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "plumber near me" have to copy your number instead of tapping to dial. And there's no booking option, so anyone wanting to schedule after hours just leaves instead of waiting to call you.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
